name: Dingiso
desc: A tree-kangaroo of subalpine forest and shrubland at about 3,250 to 4,200 m, mostly living on the ground. Endangered, mainly because of hunting and habitat loss.
about: The dingiso (), also known as the bondegezou or bakaga, is an endangered, long-tailed marsupial found only in mountain forests on the west of the island of New Guinea (in Indonesia).
